definitions.gloss: omen; sign; harbinger of something to come
definitions.explanation: A sign or indication that something is about to happen.
Notification or warning given before an event or action.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}の{前触|まえぶ}れかもしれない。
examples.english: It might be an omen of an earthquake.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}の{前触|まえぶ}れもなく{突然|とつぜん}{現|あらわ}れた。
examples.english: They appeared suddenly without any warning.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}の{前触|まえぶ}れを{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: I sense the harbingers of spring.

examples.japanese: {動物|どうぶつ}の{異常|いじょう}な{行動|こうどう}は{大|おお}きな{地震|じしん}の{前触|まえぶ}れだと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Unusual animal behavior is said to be a harbinger of a major earthquake.

examples.japanese: {前触|まえぶ}れもなく{訪|たず}ねてくるのはやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish you'd stop showing up without any advance notice.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}の{前触|まえぶ}れとして、{住民|じゅうみん}に{手紙|てがみ}が{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: As advance notice of the construction, a letter was delivered to residents.

notes:
{前触|まえぶ}れ combines {前|まえ} (before) and {触|ふ}れ (announcing): something that goes ahead of an event, either as a natural sign of it or as a deliberate announcement of it.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {前触|まえぶ}れ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ / {前触|まえぶ}れ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without warning, suddenly)
- X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前触|まえぶ}れ (a harbinger of X)
- {前触|まえぶ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there are signs, there is prior notice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{兆|きざ}し→兆し：06633_kizashi⟧: subtler, natural early signs
- ⟦{前兆|ぜんちょう}→前兆：09118_zenchou⟧: omen, usually of something significant
- ⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧: advance notice, always deliberate
- {前触|まえぶ}れ spans both: it can be a natural sign or an intentional heads-up

The negative {前触|まえぶ}れ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ is by far the most common use of the word.
